paper_title: NASDUCK: New Constraints on Axion-like Dark Matter from Floquet Quantum Detector
coupling_convention: g_aNN in GeV^-1 (derivative ALP-neutron coupling, as plotted in the paper's exclusion figures)
notes: First NASDUCK collaboration result: 129Xe-Rb Floquet magnetometer search for ALP dark matter over 5 months, constraining ALP-neutron coupling g_aNN in the mass range 4e-15 to 4e-12 eV at 95% CL, assuming rho_DM=0.4 GeV/cm^3 and epsilon_N=0.63. The precise limits are tabulated only in external repositories (GitHub/Zenodo, refs 48,65), not in the paper text; the data_points above are approximate representative values read from the described exclusion band (abstract quotes the relevant coupling scale 1e-6 to 2e-5 GeV^-1; Fig. 5C shows sensitivity ~1e-6 to 1e-5 GeV^-1 near resonance). Actual bounds vary strongly (band-like structure) around each mass. Paper also casts model-dependent ALP-proton bounds (large nuclear-structure uncertainty, possibly vanishing epsilon_P) and quadratic neutron-DM coupling bounds, not extracted here. A sensitivity projection (dashed line, ~2 years with 1 fT/sqrt(Hz) noise floor) is also shown but the primary result is a measured limit. For canonical dimensionless g_an, multiply the GeV^-1 values by 2*m_n ~ 1.88 GeV. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.5, 6))
